order_creation.stage_definition: Event triggered when a customer clicks checkout and places an order.
available_features: Type (Payment Method: DEBIT, TRANSFER, CASH, PAYMENT)
Days for shipment (scheduled: SLA committed to buyer)
Shipping Mode (Standard, First Class, Second Class, Same Day)
strictly_excluded: shipping date (DateOrders) - Timestamp of warehouse exit

dispatch.stage_definition: Event triggered when parcel is picked, packed, and handed to logistics carrier.
available_features: warehouse_processing_days (Elapsed time between order placement and dispatch)
Order Status (Status at time of handover)
strictly_excluded: Days for shipping (real) - Known only upon final customer delivery
Delivery Status - Known only upon final customer delivery
Actual delivery timestamp - Known only upon arrival

compliance_summary: All post-delivery features strictly stripped. No circular target dependence.
